people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and bronze in abundance without weight;
translations.bsb: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings, together with more bronze than could be weighed
translations.kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
translations.asv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and brass in abundance without weight;
